title: Agent Onboarding Requirement Kind
description: What a counterparty must satisfy before an onboarding mode applies. Each kind states the direction it applies to; a kind used in the other direction is ignored. Readers MUST treat an unknown kind as unsatisfiable by machine and fall back to the posture's message and url.

enumDescriptions.agent_identity: Seller gating a buyer. The buyer agent's origin is listed in its operator's trust.json with the role the seller needs (adcp:buying).
enumDescriptions.grant: Seller gating a buyer. A demand-side grant authorizes the buyer's operator for the account's brand (DR-0025); implicit when the operator is the brand.
enumDescriptions.billing_entity: Seller gating a buyer. The buyer supplies a billing entity (core/business-entity.json) on sync_accounts.
enumDescriptions.contract: Seller gating a buyer. A signed agreement exists; details at url.
enumDescriptions.credit_application: Seller gating a buyer. A credit application is completed at url, or later through sync_accounts setup.url.
enumDescriptions.aao_verified: Buyer gating a seller. The seller holds an AgenticAdvertising.org Verified badge; role is required, and verification_modes, specialisms, and adcp_version narrow it.
enumDescriptions.storyboard: Buyer gating a seller. The seller passes the named storyboard or specialism (id).
enumDescriptions.sandbox: Buyer gating a seller. The seller declares account.sandbox: true.
enumDescriptions.experimental_feature: Buyer gating a seller. The seller lists the named feature id (id) in experimental_features.
